headline: Approved April 28, 2026 minutes 5-0 and reviewed FY2027 budget cuts to Farms branch and children's room hours.
summary: The board accepted the April 28, 2026 minutes 5-0. The Library Director reported the FY2027 budget is $460.51 over the Municipal Appropriations Requirement, which will require cuts including reduced hours at the Farms branch and earlier closing of the main library children's room, pending a trash fee decision by City Council. The board also heard updates on building repairs, Friends of the Library leadership changes, and summer reading programs, and recognized former trustee Roger Morency.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the April 28, 2026 meeting, 5-0.
